gaps.sentence: She's been going ___ a difficult time at work.
Who will take ___ from the current director?
gaps.explanation: take over = take control of a job/company.

gaps.sentence: The meeting has been ___ off until Thursday.
gaps.explanation: 'Put off' = postpone to a later time.

gaps.sentence: They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.
The negotiators refused to give ___ to the hijackers' demands.
gaps.explanation: give in (to) = stop arguing and accept; give up = quit.

gaps.sentence: The match kicks ___ at three o'clock.
Please fill ___ this form and sign at the bottom.
gaps.explanation: fill in/out a form (British prefers in).

gaps.sentence: You can count ___ me if you need help.
gaps.explanation: count on somebody = rely on them.
